purpose: Teach: 製剤/仏像/床屋/駅伝/あご/観音/水銀/スマイル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、製剤会社で働いてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, your dad works at a pharmaceutical company, right?
lines.style: Light, teasing probe. Direct eye contact. The opening is casual but curious — she's gathering intel. Quick pace, easy confidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行でお寺の仏像見たろ?桜
lines.en: You saw the Buddha statues at the temple on your class trip, didn't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Mild deflection disguised as a question. Slightly embarrassed — caught noticing something. He says her name to regain ground. Quieter than expected.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、髪、床屋で切るんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you get your hair cut at the barbershop, right?
lines.style: Continues the pattern. Conversational, not confrontational. A little amused at her own rhythm. Moderate pace, leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅伝大会出るのか、桜
lines.en: Are you running in the relay race, Sakura?
lines.style: Turns the tables back on her — a beat of retaliation. Lighter tone than before, almost playful now. Slight edge underneath, but not mean.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、あごのライン気にしてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're really concerned about your jawline, aren't you?
lines.style: Sharp, wry observation. Hits him where it lands. Brief pause before the question — she's enjoying this. Tone is teasing but not cruel.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、初詣で観音様にお参りしたろ?桜
lines.en: You prayed to Kannon at the New Year shrine, didn't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet embarrassment underneath. He's been caught thinking about her. Soft delivery on her name — almost reluctant to say it. Trailing off slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、理科で水銀の実験やったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you did that mercury experiment in science class, right?
lines.style: Keeps the momentum going. Lighter again — she's circling back to safer ground. Curious tone returns, no edge this time.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスマイル、写真映えするな、桜
lines.en: Your smile really photographs well, Sakura.
lines.style: Careful sincerity. A small compliment delivered like a confession — he's been holding this. Warm but restrained. Eyes down or away. Almost gentle.
